## Report

Built the diagnostics host-emit + in-app raw console for the editor foundation (workstream B), strictly in new files.

### Files created
**Zig (`framework/diag/`)**
- `diag_registry.zig` — the host authority. Bounded ring (`RING_SIZE=2048`, inline buffers → zero-alloc emit path), per-channel table (enabled flag + cost-tier sample divisor + emitted/dropped counters), and a single pluggable `FeedSink` pointer. Imports **only std** (sinks are function pointers, event_bus/v8 are installed by the binding) so the unit test links no V8/sqlite. Public API: `init/reset`, `emit`/`emitStr`, `setEnabled`/`isEnabled`, `setSampleDiv`, `recentJson`, `channelsJson`. Disabled channel = early return; `sampled` channel keeps 1-of-N deterministically; oversized msg/fields truncate (LOUD `"trunc":1`) rather than overflow.
- `v8_bindings_editor_diag.zig` — registers the doors and installs the sink (re-broadcasts each accepted line on the `diag.feed` ffi channel via `__ffiEmit`, and mirrors to `event_bus`). Top `// INTEGRATION:` note included.
- `framework/testing/unit/diag_registry.zig` — 9 ring/sampling/escaping/state tests. **Not run** (per instructions).

**TS console (`runtime/diag/console/`)**
- `feed.ts` — live feed store: one ffi subscription to `diag.feed`, bounded ring, `__diag_recent` seed on first mount, `useSyncExternalStore` snapshot, pause/resume (freezes view without dropping data), clear, host channel-state read. Graceful no-op when doors aren't wired.
- `format.ts` — pure filter predicate (channel/severity-floor/text), copy-text serialization, clipboard via `__clipboard_set` with stashed fallback.
- `captures.ts` — named `LogCapture` creation (preserves channels/filters/time-range/buildId/requestId/mapContext/note), and a `JournalAdapter` seam (`setJournalAdapter`) so it attaches to bug/build threads **without hard-importing** workstream F's in-flight `runtime/buildjournal/`.
- `console.cls.ts` — the console's own `DC_`-prefixed classifier sheet, theme tokens only, no inline styles. Exports `C`.
- `index.tsx` — the z-indexed overlay (single default export). Channel filter, severity filter, pause/resume, clear, copy-visible, copy-recent-N (presets), jump-to-channel-toggle (mirrors `setChannelEnabled` + fires `diag.jumpToSetting`), and the create-named-capture dialog with thread attach.

### Bundle-check result
`tools/esbuild runtime/diag/console/index.tsx --bundle --outfile=/tmp/console.check.js --format=esm --alias:@reactjit=runtime` → **clean, exit 0, 237.6kb, no warnings.** (`react` resolved without an extra alias.)

### Exact Zig wiring needed (not done — shared files)
In `v8_app.zig`, beside the other binding registrations (~line 4067, near `v8_bindings_reconciler.register()`):
```zig
const editor_diag = @import("diag/v8_bindings_editor_diag.zig");
// ...
editor_diag.register();   // calls diag_registry.init() + installs the feed sink
```
No `build.zig` change is needed for the two `framework/diag/*.zig` files (plain `@import` siblings, like `v8_bindings_eventbus.zig`). The unit test needs a `build.zig` step — exact `createModule`/`addImport("diag_registry")`/`addTest` block is in the test file's header `// INTEGRATION:` note (mirrors the layout test, ~line 927).

### Contract gaps vs `runtime/diag/channel.ts` (unchanged, as required)
1. **`defineChannel()` never mirrors `defaultOn` or `costTier` to the host.** It only mirrors enabled state on toggle (`setChannelEnabled → __diag_set_enabled`). So the host can't cheaply branch a `defaultOn:false` channel for host-side emitters until JS toggles it, and can't auto-configure sample divisors for `sampled`/`heavy` tiers. Mitigation in place: host channels default to enabled + divisor 1 (safe, since JS `__diag_emit` is already pre-gated by channel.ts). Recommended fix: have `defineChannel` call `__diag_set_enabled(id, defaultOn)` and, for `sampled`/`heavy`, `__diag_set_sample(id, N)` at registration. I added `__diag_set_sample` (plus `__diag_recent`, `__diag_channels_state`) as extra doors beyond the two mandated.
2. **`.cls.ts` side-effect imports get tree-shaken.** `runtime/package.json` marks `.cls.ts` as no-side-effects, so `import './console.cls'` is dropped (classifiers vanish). Fix used: `console.cls.ts` exports `C` and `index.tsx` imports it by name (same trick `workspace.cls.ts` uses). Worth flagging to any worker authoring a classifier sheet.</result>
